scope: Check that GTK2 scrollbar stepper assets are regenerated from the active KDE color roles across four schemes; distinguish asset generation from GTK2 runtime and historical VM evidence.

method.palette_read: Read each scheme through the project's native KDE role helper; feed the resulting roles to the GTK2 scrollbar asset painter without opening a GUI or changing user configuration.
method.asset_matrix: 4 schemes × 4 states × 4 directions = 64 stepper cells; each cell is 15×15. Alpha geometry/mask is compared to DomainOS; RGB is compared to DomainOS for each alternative scheme.

isolated_native_attempt.reason: The GTK2 test harness attached to an existing coordinated preview namespace instead of creating its own. Its 640×420 captures contain only four colors and no usable rendered controls; no native color/runtime conclusion can be drawn. The child preview PID recorded by the harness closed normally. No user profile, desktop theme, or VM was changed.

isolated_native_runtime.status: GTK2 runtime state comparison verified for BreezeClassic and KvBeige; first wrapper error is documented and does not invalidate its four arrow captures
isolated_native_runtime.isolation: The harness itself created the Xvfb display and bwrap/user/network namespace under ~/tempia. namespace_created=false in the inner preview receipt is expected because preview_gtk2.py ran inside that already-private fixture; it does not indicate attachment to an external/shared renderer.
isolated_native_runtime.BreezeClassic: Real GTK2 2.24.33 preview captured all four arrow directions in hover/held/released states. The wrapper then stopped at its final full-matrix import with ModuleNotFoundError for verify_gtk2_public_capture because the test directory was absent from sys.path. A pixel comparison of preserved captures completed independently.
isolated_native_runtime.KvBeige: A focused rerun with the test directory on sys.path passed for all four directions and states; the GTK2 preview closed through its normal close path.
isolated_native_runtime.claims: For each of 8 direction×scheme cells, hover and released equal the generated normal asset (0/225 RGB differences), held equals generated pressed asset (0/225), held changes 53/225 pixels from hover, and release restores 0 differences. This proves generated GTK2 recipe rendering in the isolated runtime for these two alternate palettes; not VUE fidelity or desktop-wide live scheme switching.

result.status: asset-level palette following verified across four schemes; isolated GTK2 2.24.33 state rendering verified for BreezeClassic and KvBeige; historical VUE fidelity remains partial
result.geometry: All 64 cells remain 15×15 and their alpha masks are identical across all four schemes.
result.color: All 48 cells in BreezeClassic, BreezeDark, and KvBeige differ from DomainOS in RGB across the 225-pixel cell while preserving the same alpha mask. The painter derives RGB from KDE Button roles; no final RGB constants were added.
result.native_runtime: Eight direction×scheme cells across BreezeClassic and KvBeige match their generated normal/pressed assets exactly; 53 pixels change while held and release restores the exact normal cell.

remaining: Finish the enabled horizontal VUE arrow held-state comparison using a stable, verified pointer route; R435 was inconclusive and no arrow was pressed.
Native SR10.4 hover/insensitive appearance, whole-family comparison, current open-application in-memory theme resolution, and human visual review remain separate pending evidence/acceptance.
The GTK2 runtime proof covers two alternate schemes; it does not establish desktop-wide live refresh or cover every other palette.
